stage.title: Implement single-step debug and validation dumps

goal: Add a debug-only single-step RenderGraph execution mode and a validation dump layer that prints graph parameters, RG resources, resolved RHI resources, barriers, fences, and formatted synchronization graphs without changing scheduling decisions.
entry_gate: The contract replacement checkpoint has frozen the public RenderGraph construction and execution contract.
The barrier and queue synchronization checkpoint produces explicit barrier/fence plans.
The async record and submit checkpoint submits through RHIExecutor and can run normal asynchronous execution.
The platform external interop checkpoint represents platform-command-list external passes as explicit graph nodes.

hard_rules.rule: Single-step mode is selected only by console variables sampled before graph construction or graph scope entry. Do not switch execution mode inside an active RenderGraph.
Single-step mode is debug-only. It must not become the normal scheduling path and must not preserve async batching behavior.
In single-step mode, AddPass records, submits through RHIExecutor, waits for GPU completion, and publishes a boundary receipt before returning.
Validation dumps are read-only. They must never feed data back into scheduling, allocation, barrier, fence, or queue decisions.
Validation output must include graph parameters, RG resources, resolved RHI resources, barriers, fences, queue handoffs, external platform-command-list nodes, and boundary receipts when enabled.

checkpoints.title: Implement debug cvar snapshot and scope guard
checkpoints.problem: Changing debug mode while a graph is being declared or dispatched would make half the graph use one execution model and half the graph use another.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: RenderGraph snapshots RenderGraph.Debug.SingleStep, RenderGraph.Validation.DumpParameters, RenderGraph.Validation.DumpResources, RenderGraph.Validation.DumpSyncGraph, and RenderGraph.Validation.DumpDirectory before graph construction or graph scope entry.
The snapshot is stored in RGDebugController and is immutable for the lifetime of the graph.
Cvar changes while a graph is active are rejected or deferred to the next graph with a clear diagnostic.
Normal mode and single-step mode are selected from the snapshot only.

checkpoints.title: Implement single-step record-submit-sync execution
checkpoints.problem: Synchronization and resource-state bugs are hard to isolate when the graph batches barriers and records passes in parallel. A debug path should expose one pass boundary at a time.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: In single-step mode, AddSetupPass executes declaration work immediately.

In single-step mode, AddPass validates that required setup declarations exist, compiles a one-pass plan from the current boundary state, records one RHICommandList, submits through RHIExecutor, waits for GPU completion, and publishes a boundary receipt before returning.
Platform-command-list external passes emit an immediate RHI platform callback command; backend translate executes the callback and the same per-pass GPU wait synchronizes it.
Single-step mode disables async setup, async compile, parallel record, cross-pass barrier batching, and transient aliasing across future passes.
Normal mode output is unchanged when the cvar is disabled.

checkpoints.title: Dump graph parameters and resources
checkpoints.problem: Debugging missing declarations and wrong resource bindings requires seeing both graph-level objects and resolved RHI objects in one deterministic dump.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Validation can print graph.Alloc<T>() parameter metadata: type id, byte size, owning pass, and referenced RG resources.
Validation can print RG resource descriptors, import/export state, declared accesses, lifetime interval, alias slot, pool eligibility, and resolved view data.
Validation can print resolved RHI resource identity, debug name, backend handle class, usage flags, last known whole-resource state, owner queue, and pool entry id when available.
Dump order is deterministic by graph id, pass id, resource id, and declaration order.

checkpoints.title: Dump barrier and fence synchronization graphs
checkpoints.problem: Barrier and fence errors need a readable graph that shows pass/resource edges, queue handoffs, waits, signals, and insertion points instead of only raw backend barriers.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Validation can print barrier batches as text tables with pass id, resource id, range, source state, destination state, access, stage, queue, and insertion point.
Validation can print fence and queue handoff tables with producer segment, consumer segment, wait token, signal token, queue ids, and resource ranges.
Validation emits DOT files for pass/resource dependency graph and barrier/fence synchronization graph.
External platform-command-list nodes, raw RHI receipts, multi-graph import/export edges, and present/export tails appear in the graph output.
Dumping is side-effect free and can run after compile or after single-step pass execution.

checkpoints.title: Add focused debug and validation tests
checkpoints.problem: Debug paths often drift from normal execution unless tests prove mode snapshotting, per-pass sync, and dump determinism.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Tests prove cvar changes do not switch mode inside an active graph.
Tests prove single-step mode submits and waits once per declared pass.
Tests prove normal mode keeps async compile/record behavior when single-step is disabled.
Tests prove validation dumps contain graph parameters, RG resources, RHI resources, barriers, fences, and formatted graph output.
Tests run through existing repository scripts.

stage_exit_gate: Single-step debug mode is selected before graph scope and cannot switch mid-graph.
Each AddPass in single-step mode records, submits, GPU-syncs, and publishes a boundary receipt before returning.
Validation dumps include graph parameters, RG resources, resolved RHI resources, barriers, fences, queue handoffs, external nodes, and boundary receipts.
Validation graph output is deterministic and side-effect free.
validation: Run testscripts/windows/test_rhi_translate.ps1 after focused debug and validation tests land.
Run testscripts/windows/test_all.ps1 after the stage-sized landing.
